issues.description: fixed_audio_packet_size buffering complects concerns and lacks validation for size, type, and tail handling
issues.detail: The new _write_frame path accumulates any bytes payload into a mutable buffer and chunks it, entangling buffering, pacing, and serialization. It accepts any int (no sample-width alignment check), treats non-audio bytes as PCM, and never flushes the sub-packet remainder on stream end. Extract chunking as a pure function, gate on AudioRawFrame, validate alignment, and define end-of-stream behavior.

issues.description: Packet size expressed in bytes has no time/format semantics and silently mismatches sample rate
issues.detail: Callers must hand-compute 640 = 20ms * 16kHz * 2 bytes. There is no stated invariant tying packet_bytes to vonage_sample_rate or sample width, and PCM16 is asserted in comments but never enforced. A misconfigured value or upstream format change produces wrong-duration or garbled audio with no error. Accept a duration or assert the contract.

issues.description: Resampler tail and state not flushed/reset; trailing audio dropped and interruption leaves stale filter state
issues.detail: Vonage serializer's stateful input/output resamplers are never flushed at end-of-stream or reset on StartFrame/reconfigure, so the final partial frame is lost and a mid-session rate change carries stale state. The transport buffer is cleared on interruption but the resampler state is not. Either document statelessness or wire flush/reset.

issues.description: DTMF parsing accepts two undocumented payload shapes instead of pinning the Vonage contract
issues.detail: `message.get('digit') or message.get('dtmf', {}).get('digit')` encodes uncertainty as behavior. Pick the shape from the Vonage spec, log loudly when the other appears, and remove the fallback. Defensive 'try both' branches hide protocol drift and tend to survive forever.

issues.description: Renaming audio_packet_bytes to fixed_audio_packet_size is a silent breaking change
issues.detail: The param sits on a public dataclass with Optional default None, so existing users of audio_packet_bytes lose packetization silently rather than erroring. Either keep a deprecated alias for one release or flag the break loudly in the changelog's changed section.

issues.description: Chunking logic is untested and bytearray drain is O(n^2) in the worst case
issues.detail: The while-loop chunker is a pure function pretending to be a method, with no unit tests. `del self._audio_send_buffer[:packet_bytes]` shifts remaining bytes each iteration; negligible for 20ms packets but quadratic on large bursts. Extract `chunk_pcm(buffer, size) -> (chunks, remainder)`, test it, and consider memoryview or a deque if measurement warrants.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees this PR is NEEDS-WORK but salvageable. The Vonage serializer is roughly the right shape, but the new fixed_audio_packet_size path on FastAPIWebsocketTransport tangles buffering, pacing, and serialization into _write_frame, treats any bytes payload as PCM, lacks alignment/format validation, and never flushes the sub-packet tail. Packet size is expressed in bytes when the real concept is duration-at-a-rate, inviting silent mismatches. The rename of audio_packet_bytes is a quiet breaking change, and DTMF parsing accepts two undocumented shapes. Extract chunking as a pure tested function, gate it on AudioRawFrame, pin the protocol contracts, and define resampler flush/reset semantics.
